# Viz QA Checklist

- Business question matches the chosen indicator(s)
- Execution entity is canonical or intentionally selected
- Grain supports the intended chart
- Time field is explicit
- Filter values were validated
- Breakdown columns exist on the execution entity
- Rate numerator / denominator fields were verified
- Comparison window is explicit
- Weekly comparisons are weekday-aligned unless specified otherwise
- Month/year comparisons are calendar/date-aligned unless specified otherwise
- Null / zero handling is defined
- Method reference is captured
- SQL or recipe validation was bounded
- Unsupported slices are documented
